name: @brandos/publishing-layer
description: Publishing Foundation (Phase 10) — the system of record for what BrandOS has produced, decided, and distributed. Owns Artifact/ArtifactVersion/Approval/Destination/Publication/DistributionJob/PublishEvent lifecycle and audit trail. Never renders, never regenerates — consumes render outputs from Rendering V2 and governance policy from @brandos/governance-config. See PUBLISHING_ARCHITECTURE_V1.md.
